season.leap_rule: the axis has no Feb 29; in a leap year Feb 29's value is added into the Feb 28 day, so a season's final is the sum of all its calendar days

base.rule: every complete season, full record, excluding the current season

enso.mapping: water year N (Oct 1 N-1 → Sep 30 N) → ENSO year N-1

now.basis: El Niño developing, latest ONI 1.8 (JJA), 4 seasons; a label for the current state, read from CPC's index as the catalog banks it; not a forecast

source.method: GHCNd daily precipitation at the station, summed from the season's first day over the days that reported. In the season in progress a missing or null day adds nothing and does not stop the sum; the season says how many days are missing, and with more than 5 the readout is withheld. A past season joins the base only when every day reported.
